Name: (CP) Penguins
Author: macro191
Description:
[size=5][b][CP] Penguins[/b][/size]
A Content Patcher pack that adds late-game penguins with a discovery event, branching outcomes, and a full GMCM-ready config system.

[center][b]Final Update Note
[/b]Hey everyone,
This will be my final update for this mod. I want to thank everyone who has used it—it was truly created as a fun side project, and I'm glad it resonated with some of you.
Unfortunately, I've found that some in the modding community can be a little unwelcoming to newcomers, which has diminished my enthusiasm for continuing development
That said, the mod will remain available as-is. If anyone wants to take it over or continue development, feel free to reach out.
Thanks for everything![/center]

[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Adds [b]Black Penguin[/b] and [b]Blue Penguin[/b] farm animals.
[*]Blue encounter outcomes:
[list]
[*][b]Adopt[/b]: receive a Blue Penguin Egg.
[*][b]Send to Marnie[/b]: unlock blue shop purchase.
[*][b]Leave Wild[/b]: enables year-limited seasonal wild bonus events.
[/list][*]Blue unlock mode options: [code]StoryEvent[/code], [code]ShopOnly[/code], [code]Both[/code].
[*]Seasonal byproduct economy with multiplier tiers.
[*]Balance presets: [code]Custom[/code], [code]VanillaLike[/code], [code]Balanced[/code], [code]Hardcore[/code], [code]ProfitHeavy[/code].
[*]Debug levels: [code]Off[/code], [code]Errors[/code], [code]Verbose[/code].
[*]English and Spanish localization.
[/list]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]SMAPI
[*]Content Patcher
[*](Optional) Generic Mod Config Menu
[/list]

[size=4][b]Config Overview[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]General[/b]: ConfigMode, BalancePreset
[*][b]Unlock[/b]: BlueUnlockMode, BlueEncounterSeason, BlueEncounterChance
[*][b]Economy[/b]: UseSeasonalPricing, AnimalPriceMultiplier, ItemPriceMultiplier, SummerPriceMultiplier, WinterPriceMultiplier
[*][b]Direct Values[/b]: animal prices, maturity, produce cadence, friendship gates, item prices
[*][b]Debug[/b]: DebugLevel
[/list]

[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Event IDs use high range [code]971xx[/code] to reduce conflict risk.
[*]If other mods edit the same event IDs or farm animal entries, load order can affect behavior.
[*]Do not keep duplicate copies with the same [code]UniqueId[/code].
[/list]

[size=4][b]Support[/b][/size]
If reporting issues, include:
[list]
[*]SMAPI log
[*]Mod list
[*]Your [code]config.json[/code]
[*]Encounter branch chosen (Adopt / Marnie / Wild)
[/list]
